thread.title: Microsoft's stock surges toward another record high - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Microsoft's stock surges toward another record high - MarketWatch
text:
Published: July 23, 2018 10:43 a.m. ET Share Tomi Kilgore Reporter and editor
Shares of Microsoft Corp. MSFT, +1.31% surged 1.5% toward a second-straight record high, in the wake the software giant's better-than-expected fiscal fourth-quarter results . The stock's rally has lifted Microsoft's market capitalization to $828.3 billion to close in on Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, +0.70% which is the third-largest U.S. company by market cap, at $835.5 billion. Microsoft is still well behind second-place Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, -0.67% at $874.6 billion and first-place Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.01% at $935.2 billion. Microsoft's stock rose 1.8% on Friday after results were reported late Thursday. It has run up 26% year to date, while the Nasdaq Composite COMP, +0.21% has rallied 13% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.02% has gained 1.2%. Quote References
